# Mini Season: "The Sunset Stranger" - Sunset Sarsaparilla Theme (Dec 2025)

![Mini Season: `The Sunset Stranger` - Sunset Sarsaparilla Theme (Dec 2025)](/uploads/612_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update December 24th, 2025] Tip for the challenge Modify a pistol

Get ready for a new unannounced mini season: "The Sunset Stranger". The Mini Season is all about Sunset Sarsaparilla and includes some western style rewards.

This mini season was already included in the data on the last PTS, but there was never a date for a period. Now some players have received an email announcing this mini season, so we now know that the Sunset Stranger mini season starts on December 23rd, 2025.

![Mini Season: the Sunset Stranger Announcement](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mini-season-sunset-stranger-email.jpeg) 

### Mini Season Period:

**December 23, 2025 6:00 p.m. - January 6, 2026 6:00 p.m.**

This mini season will also have a new area next to the season. If you press "Season" in the main menu, a selection will open in which you can choose the current season 23 or the mini season. In both you can collect the rewards with the same tickets.

Tickets are earned as usual through the daily and weekly challenges.

## Free Challenge Item

### Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat

Show those weak-chested Nuka sippers what drink is the law here with the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat!

- THIS CLOTHING CAN BE CRAFTED AT ARMOR WORKBENCHES. -

*Note:* This time it is again possible to complete the challenges in power armor. There is a new function in the challenges called "WornInOrOutOfPowerArmor", which detects if you wear a costume before entering the PA and counts it towards the challenges.
